commit.body:
Reserve each ledger number in the shared state.db before writing its git
record, reuse an owner's open reservation across next and add, and report
unfiled reservations with their owner and age.

Keep origin-aware highest-number reads and mark filed reservations with
their row path. Declare the ledger's state engine as SQLite.
